metadata.label: negative
metadata.prompt: Describe this image and judge whether it is physically reasonable.
metadata.reference: Realistic image of a metal door handle mounted on a solid wooden door, the cylindrical handle extends straight through the door panel and protrudes equally on both sides with no visible mounting hardware or cutout, no text, no watermark.
metadata.rationale: The handle passes through the solid wood without a drilled hole or mounting plate, violating basic structural assembly.
